newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-CHINA CONSIDERS LEGAL BETTING ON MATCHES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHINA CONSIDERS LEGAL BETTING ON MATCHES.

text.p: Chinese sports authorities are considering a plan to allow legalised gambling on soccer matches, officials said on Friday.

Under a proposal by the State Sports Commission, punters could buy tickets betting on winners and losers as well as differences in goals scored in matches of China's professional soccer league, a commission official said.
"It is like horse racing. People buy the lottery tickets then choose the team they think will win," the official said without giving further details.
Gambling is still a sensitive issue in China and the plan has not yet received all the necessary approvals.
The State Council, or cabinet, would have to rule on the proposal before it could move forward, the official said.
Most forms of gambling are illegal in communist-ruled China, but betting on horse racing is allowed.
